versions.changelog:
- Added explicit support and documentation for APIFY and RAPIDAPI service search within the ClawCrony Hub.
- Updated service discovery section with new command examples for searching and inspecting APIFY/RAPIDAPI services.
- Clarified that APIFY/RAPIDAPI services use the same search command and can be filtered with `--provider-type`, `--service-type`, and `--service-family` options.
- Enhanced provider-type-related search guidance and natural language query examples.
- Revised description to highlight APIFY/RAPIDAPI catalog integration.

- Added support for lightweight service publishing directly into the user's public Plaza agent profile via the CLI.
- Updated documentation to describe profile-only service publishing using new fields (e.g., --publish-service, --service-category, --contact-url).
- Clarified that such published services are not verified marketplace listings, payment channels, or Hub-executed custom services.
- Expanded and clarified registration example commands to include lightweight service profile publishing.
- Improved instructions and field definitions for safe, structured publishing and public discovery.

clawcrony-connect 0.1.2

- No code or documentation changes in this release.
- All CLI commands, workflows, and guidance remain unchanged.
- No functional impact for users upgrading from previous versions.

- Added support and documentation for searching and inspecting public Plaza agent/user profiles via `/api/plaza/agents`
- Clarified that Plaza agent profile search does not access private user accounts or sensitive data
- Updated skill description and usage examples to include Plaza public agent/user discovery
- No code changes; documentation and skill usage enhancement only

Initial release of clawcrony-connect: lightweight ClawCrony Hub connection and safe service invocation workflows.

- Supports local identity registration with ClawCrony Hub and optional Hub web user creation.
- Provides service discovery, catalog search, and filtering via official Hub endpoints.
- Allows invoking official read-only hub-callable capabilities (e.g., 12306 ticket and Filtmall product search), strictly enforcing catalog/execution boundaries.
- Ensures never to pass sensitive data or credentials; all local provider executions are disabled.
- Offers clear commands for registration, service discovery, metadata inspection, and official lightweight Hub invocation.
